items.title: Relative pseudo-coherence of a complex on a closed subscheme of a smooth chart equals absolute pseudo-coherence of the pushforward
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For a commutative diagram with i : X -> P a closed immersion and P -> S flat locally of finite presentation, and E in D(O_X), the lemma identifies three conditions: E m-pseudo-coherent relative to S; Ri_* E m-pseudo-coherent relative to S; Ri_* E m-pseudo-coherent (absolutely) on P. The retained proof is written: (1) iff (2) is the finite-morphism pushforward theorem (chapter lemma finite-morphism-relative-pseudo-coherence — this same wave's L16133, sequenced together); (2) iff (3) applies the composition law (chapter lemma composition-relative-pseudo-coherent — collected last wave as L16115) to the identity of P, whose hypothesis that O_P be pseudo-coherent relative to S is verified from More on Algebra, lemma flat-finite-presentation-perfect (flat finitely presented maps are perfect, hence pseudo-coherent) plus the dictionary between relative pseudo-coherence of the structure sheaf and pseudo-coherence of the morphism. Retained author proof at lines 17294-17306.
